visualCharacteristics: Full-width overlay banner: a background cover image with a dark scrim, overlaid with a heading, subheading, and a single CTA button. Text is light-on-dark and vertically centered.
contentPattern: Row 1: background image. Row 2: heading + subheading + CTA button.
usage: Use for a prominent full-bleed call-to-action banner where text sits over a photographic background.
